name: Bounded cloud JSON journal recovery
capability: Recover one complete saved cloud JSON journal through bounded read-only execution commands. Binds byte chunks to observed file identity, decodes strict UTF-8, verifies complete SHA256/byte count with the supplied helper and returns exact text/JSON without file writes, provider calls, retries or effect replay.
next_gap: Recovered snapshots remain historical data; their existing operation consumer must reconcile canonical provider state before any next mutation.
